content:
Defend the Raider Camp from attack is a quest in Fallout 76.

Background

The raiders at Ohio River Adventures are essential to the western flank of Crater, but also have to deal with ornery and aggressive mirelurks. The Vault 76 dwellers can choose to assist them.

Walkthrough

This is a straightforward wave defense quest. Mirelurks will come in three waves with a brief downtime between each attack. The most important reward from the quest aren't the caps, but the reputation boost with Crater raiders.
